notes.title: 🧠 Lobotomy is out now — enter a surreal and unsettling world
notes.content:
Lobotomy is a short, story-driven game that invites you into a dreamlike, weirdcore-inspired world filled with strange beauty and quiet horror.

Explore abandoned places, witness surreal nature, and uncover the fragmented memories of a mind on the edge. Designed to be completed in one sitting, Lobotomy offers about 2 hours of immersive storytelling, striking visuals, and an atmosphere that lingers long after the screen fades to black.

🪵 Weirdcore aesthetic & hauntingly beautiful nature
🧠 Emotional, introspective narrative
🌙 Perfect for fans of short, artistic experiences
